name: Introduction to Quantum Communications and Cryptography
description: Review of linear algebra and Hilbert spaces; postulates of quantum mechanics; quantum states and measurement; quantum channels; composite systems and entanglement; bell measurement and CHSH inequality; no-cloning theorem; purification; distance measures; classical information theory: Shannon's entropy, mutual information, source and channel coding; quantum information theory: von-Neumann entropy, Holevo information, quantum channel capacity; QKD protocols; discrete variable QKD (DV-QKD): BB84, BBM92, E91, COW, DPS; continuous variable QKD (CV-QKD): GG02 protocol, security analysis, Gaussian quantum information theory; quantum networks; post quantum cryptography (PQC).
